mentions.name: All-in-One Event Management Platform
mentions.description: All-in-one event management platform for studios and event planners, combining a CRM, expense tracking, equipment management, and an event gallery with photo sharing, face detection-based downloads, and guest uploads; currently being migrated from cloud-hosted Supabase to a self-hosted version.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Im working on a all-in-one event management platform for studios, event planner etc..,

It consists of CRM, Expense tracking, Equipment Management, Event Gallery( photo share, Face Detection based download, Guest Upload) etc..,
